I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the store was Pine Crossing.

That comes from her own post in #central-team on Jun 9. She wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, and that a driver who arrived at 7:10 was logged on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template.

I couldn't find an address or site code for Pine Crossing in anything Pree can see. If her account sheet needs more than the store name, I told her store ops will have to give it to her.
